definitions.explanation: A leisure activity of going to an orchard to pick and eat apples, popular as an autumn outing.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}にりんご{狩|が}りに{行|い}った。
examples.english: We went apple picking in autumn.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}でりんご{狩|が}りを{楽|たの}しんだ。
この{農園|のうえん}では{時間|じかん}{制限|せいげん}なしでりんご{狩|が}りが{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: At this orchard you can enjoy apple picking with no time limit.

notes:
Formed from りんご (apple) + {狩|が}り (gathering, picking), with rendaku making it がり. The suffix {狩|が}り is used for going out to gather or pick produce, as in ぶどう{狩|が}り (grape picking) and いちご{狩|が}り (strawberry picking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- りんご{狩|が}りに{行|い}く: go apple picking
- りんご{狩|が}りを{楽|たの}しむ: enjoy apple picking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潮干狩|しおひが}り: clam digging — another {狩|が}り outing
- ぶどう{狩|が}り: grape picking — a parallel fruit-picking activity
